This page will explain the research agenda in a few durable themes rather than simply listing every paper.

## Research themes

### Climate and environmental economics
Questions about incentives, mitigation, transition pathways, and policy design.

### Agricultural and land-use transitions
Questions about production, land allocation, environmental constraints, and transition exposure.

### Computational and synthetic-population modelling
Methods for representing heterogeneous farms, households, places, and behaviours.

### Policy design and distributional effects
How policy costs, benefits, risks, and adjustment burdens are distributed.

## From questions to reproducible outputs

Each major project can connect its paper, model documentation, code repository, data, figures, talks, and related writing.
